title: Platform-Specific API Leak in Pure Domain Abstractions
pattern: Operating-system or platform-specific types (like Win32 handles or POSIX file descriptors) bleeding directly into core domain model structs.
why_bad: It violates portability and abstraction integrity. It makes it impossible to run the application on different platforms or mock the environment for fast unit tests.
detection: Look for platform-specific types or conditional imports (like `#[cfg(target_os = "windows")]`) inside domain entity structures.
counterexample: Low-level system drivers or OS utility libraries where platform integration is the explicit purpose. Marked `Context-dependent`.
fix: Encapsulate the OS handle behind an abstract file trait or generic stream adapter.
source: *Kill It with Fire* by Marianne Bellotti (2021), p. 136, 523.
